title: Trends and change
description: Describe trends, shifts, and long-term change with precision.

introduction.headline: Talk about trends clearly
introduction.body: You will learn vocabulary for describing patterns of change and practise summarising what the data shows.
introduction.bodyIt: Imparerai vocabolario per descrivere andamenti e praticherai a riassumere ciò che mostrano i dati.
objectives: Use passive structures to report findings
Summarise a change in clear English

vocabulary.example: Remote work has become a major trend.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Il lavoro da remoto è diventato una tendenza importante.

vocabulary.example: There has been a clear shift towards hybrid work.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: C'è stato un chiaro spostamento verso il lavoro ibrido.

vocabulary.example: Costs have gradually increased over the decade.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: I costi sono aumentati gradualmente nel corso del decennio.

exercises.explanation: A trend is a general pattern or direction of change over time.

exercises.prompt: There has been a clear ____ towards hybrid work.
exercises.promptIt: Completa: There has been a clear ____ towards hybrid work.
exercises.explanation: Shift refers to a noticeable change in direction or preference.

review.tip: Describe one workplace or technology trend in two sentences today.
